digest.component_or_area: bridge pause/resume and gate state management
propositions: Pause and resume operations must safely mutate and read a dual-format remote blob retaining both gated_mode: reconcile-check and pause metadata (paused, reason, who, paused_at) while remaining readable by old reconciler versions
Pause must emit exactly one anchored rc-0 BRIDGE_PAUSED JSON marker and block before lock acquisition or ticket mutation; the scheduled workflow recognizes only this marker to skip commit-and-push

Pause provenance (repository git user.email and first-pause RFC3339 timestamp) must be enforced; same-reason pause is idempotent, different-reason or blank reason pause refuses without overwrite, and resume uses observed OID CAS to safely recover corrupt state
Legacy gate rc 4, old reconcile --mode vocabulary, and pre-gate reconcile-check early return must remain functional without regression
Corrupt pause blob must emit clean rc-1 recovery line without traceback and be repairable by resume without decoding

The public contract (CLI help, reference docs, user guide, exit codes, release notes) must expose pause/resume commands while excluding --until, automatic expiry, gate rename, and old-vocabulary removal
